verdict.rationale: Reclaim's own docs describe a Schedule Assistant that "highlights what needs attention and suggests what to do next" and an AI chat assistant to plan, prioritize, and optimize the schedule. Time analytics on meetings, tasks, and work-life balance metrics add data-driven insights inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what insights and suggestions are generated and how they are derived from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI suggestion features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
